regime_context: China A-shares tape is a narrow, one-narrative rotation: Coal holds sole eligible leadership with modest durability (0.52) and a mean-revert Hurst tag, while Banks — the only other eligible name — is crowded. The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), and the desk's own track record shows direction accuracy near coin-flip (0.337), so the honest default here is low conviction and few theses.
emerging_watch: Watching Gold Miners' near-leadership (rank 2, challenger, score 0.935, hurst_tag=trend) as a potential durability handoff candidate. It is not eligible and not scorable, so no call yet — I am watching whether it crosses the eligibility gate AND stays durable if Coal breaks down.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme that is simultaneously eligible (above the absolute-trend gate), the rotation leader, and not crowded, with one-narrative leadership intact. The trend-gate eligibility is retained here only as a display-condition — not because it carried edge historically — so the lean rests on it being the singular uncrowded eligible leader, which is a durability statement, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: The hurst_tag is mean-revert and durability is only 0.52, so leadership could fade quickly in a whipsawing tape — and rank-IC is ~0, meaning leadership concentration does not forecast return on this market.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and highly durable (0.83) but crowded (z=1.83) — and the guardrail says never fade a crowded leader, only cap or de-prioritize it. Given one-narrative dominance sits with Coal, not Banks, there is no standalone reason to overweight Banks; avoid is the cleaner default while crowding is elevated and leadership is elsewhere.
evidence: one_narrative=true, leader is Coal not Banks
theses.dissent: Banks are the most durable eligible theme (breadth=1.0, trend Hurst tag) and would be the strongest candidate if crowding unwinds without a momentum breakdown — so avoid could miss a rotation into the only other gate-eligible name.

falsifier.text: Banks' crowding_z falls below 1.0 and Coal loses gate eligibility before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
